title: Side Marker Lights LED 20-Pack – 12V for Car & Truck
descriptionHtml:
A full set of marker lights

Marker lights make the vehicle visible from the side and increase safety. Buying them one by one gets both expensive and time-consuming.

20 lights in one package

This 20-pack of round 12V LED lights is enough for the whole vehicle. They are small, durable and easy to mount on a car, truck and trailer.

Features

  • 20-pack of round LED lights
  • Powered by 12V
  • Small and durable
  • Easy to mount
  • Great for cars, trucks and trailers

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
